report.explanation: All current read-only telemetry is healthy: gateway traces OK, logs 200, and gateway/order/payment/inventory metrics show error_rate 0.0012, p95 73ms, zero timeouts and zero pool waiters. No evidence supports any taxonomy cause. The payment deployment record (3.1.5, 1465 min old, valid config) cannot establish deployment-caused latency. Alert claims degradation not corroborated by current observations, so hand off for evidence of the actual fault.
missing_evidence: Telemetry showing actual checkout degradation (elevated error rate or latency) in the alert window; current traces/metrics/logs show healthy OK/200 with p95 73ms and error_rate 0.0012.
Per-service latency breakdown across order, payment, inventory to localize any downstream latency.
Dependency timeout or db_pool_waiter evidence for db-pool-exhaustion or redis-timeout candidates.
Memory-retention time series per service to assess memory-leak; single snapshot is insufficient.
